test_executor_get_state: test the WorkerExecutor get_state method to verify it returns the current worker state from the state file
test_executor_heartbeat: test the WorkerExecutor heartbeat method to verify it updates the job's last heartbeat timestamp in the queue
test_executor_kill_zombies: test the WorkerExecutor kill_zombies method to verify it deletes jobs that have stopped sending heartbeats
test_executor_start: test the WorkerExecutor start method to verify it spawns a worker loop process and monitors heartbeats and zombies
test_executor_stops_on_long_job: test the WorkerExecutor start method to verify it kills jobs that exceed the maximum allowed duration
